provenance.reference: Original 5x5 border concept sheet generated in this chat
provenance.method: Each motif was extracted individually with transparent_background=true. Selected outputs were corrected to remove white interior fills or clipped edges. Original generated PNG files are copied unchanged; alpha-bound cropping and tinting happen in the renderer.

petal.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the attached original 5x5 numbered label-border design sheet. design 25, fifth row fifth column: extract ONLY the single small daisy-like flower centered on the bottom border. Preserve its original rounded petals and circular center. Exclude adjacent leafy sprigs and the wavy frame line. Faithfully extract and clean up this original illustration, preserving its original silhouette, proportions, expressive details and black ink line style; do not redesign it. Deliver ONE isolated high-resolution transparent PNG with clean antialiased black strokes, tightly framed with a small even transparent margin. Remove all text, numbers, unrelated art and every bit of the label frame. All white background, including white interior regions of the line drawing, must become genuinely transparent. No baseline, surrounding box, gray background, checkerboard pixels, color, shadows or extra objects.
